observable_claims: Harry catches glass ball in flight

action: casts Lumos Solem conjuring blast of blinding sunlight recoiling Devil Snare tendrils
dialogue_ref: Devil's Snare, Devil's Snare... it hates sunlight! Lumos Solem!
visual_description: Hermione points her wand upward shouting Lumos Solem; a beam of bright solar light bursts forth, causing the choking vines to shrink and drop Ron.

action: catches Golden Snitch with left hand while right arm hangs broken from rogue Bludger strike
dialogue_ref: Harry Potter has caught the Snitch! Gryffindor wins!
visual_description: The heavy iron Bludger snaps Harry's right arm; Harry dives into the sand rolling and holds up the fluttering Golden Snitch in his left hand.
observable_claims: Harry holds Golden Snitch in hand

action: casts Brackium Emendo vanishing all bones from Harry's right arm leaving it a rubbery sleeve
dialogue_ref: Brackium Emendo! Ah, yes, well, that can sometimes happen. But the point is, the bones are no longer broken!
visual_description: Lockhart twirls his wand over Harry's broken arm; the arm instantly deflates like a rubber glove, bending floppily in all directions without bones.
observable_claims: Lockhart wiggles Harry's completely limp boneless arm

action: swells like giant round balloon floating through French doors into night sky
location: 4 Privet Drive dining room and backyard sky
dialogue_ref: Vernon! Vernon, do something! Marge!
visual_description: Aunt Marge's buttons pop as her body expands into a massive sphere; she floats across the ceiling and out the glass doors into the night sky.

action: gasps and drops porcelain teacup trembling as she spots the black Grim dog omen
visible_objects: black soggy tea leaves shaped like dog
dialogue_ref: My dear... you have... the Grim! The Grim! Taking the form of a giant spectral dog!
visual_description: Professor Trelawney peers through her giant spectacles into Harry's teacup, screams, and drops it onto the saucer gasping that he has the Grim.
observable_claims: Trelawney looks into cup and gasps
Tea dregs show black dog silhouette

action: touches scruffy old work boot portkey spinning through vortex and landing on grassy hillside
dialogue_ref: Three, two, one... Let go! I bet that cleared your sinuses!
visual_description: The group holds onto the dirty boot, gets sucked into a kaleidoscopic sky vortex, and crashes tumbling onto the grass while Arthur and Cedric float gracefully down.
observable_claims: Travelers tumble out of sky onto grass

action: points wand at enlarged spider on desk casting Crucio causing it to writhe in agony
location: Defense Against the Dark Arts classroom
dialogue_ref: Crucio! Stop it! Can't you see it's bothering him?! Stop it!
visual_description: Moody points his wand at the spider; it squeals and contorts violently in pain as Neville grips his desk white-knuckled in horror.
observable_claims: Spider contorts in pain on desk

action: pulls hideous maroon dress robes with frilly lace collar from parcel holding against body
visible_objects: frilly white lace cuffs and collar
dialogue_ref: Mum sent me a dress?! Well, it does match your eyes. Is there a bonnet? Aha!
visual_description: Ron pulls the musty velvet robes from the box, holding the ruffled lace collar up to his chin while Harry and the twins burst out laughing.
observable_claims: Ron holds up frilly velvet robes

action: tosses slab of raw meat to winged skeletal black Thestral in snowy forest
dialogue_ref: They're called Thestrals. You're not going mad. I can see them too. You're just as sane as I am.
visual_description: Luna stands barefoot in the snow, tossing a piece of raw meat to a gaunt black winged Thestral, smiling gently at Harry.
observable_claims: Luna feeds raw meat to black winged beast

action: kisses Cho Chang beneath floating mistletoe in empty Room of Requirement
visible_objects: floating green mistletoe with white berries
dialogue_ref: Mistletoe. Probably full of Nargles. What are Nargles? No idea.
visual_description: Harry and tearful Cho look up at the magical mistletoe sprouting from the ceiling; they lean in and share a tender first kiss.

action: yanks back black suit sleeve revealing snake and skull Dark Mark tattooed on pale arm
dialogue_ref: I have to do this! He's gonna kill me! He'll kill my whole family!
visual_description: Draco aggressively rolls back his left cuff, shoving his pale forearm forward to show the faded black skull and snake Dark Mark.
observable_claims: Dark Mark tattoo visible on pale skin

action: extracts silvery memory thread from temple with wand tip into glass flask
dialogue_ref: Please don't think badly of me when you see it. You have no idea what he was like, even then.
visual_description: Tearful Slughorn presses his wand to his temple and slowly draws out the thick glowing silver strand of memory, dropping it into Harry's glass vial.
observable_claims: Slughorn pulls silver memory strand from temple
Memory strand placed into glass bottle

action: apparates into kitchen tackling thief Mundungus Fletcher to flagstone floor
dialogue_ref: Kreacher has returned with the thief Fletcher! Get off me, you bleeding parasite!
visual_description: With a loud crack, Kreacher and Dobby appear wrestling the swearing Mundungus Fletcher onto the stone kitchen floor.

action: shines lantern inspecting Harry's grotesquely swollen stung face in forest
dialogue_ref: What happened to you, ugly? The sting will wear off, won't it? Don't look at me!
visual_description: Scabior thrusts his lantern into Harry's swollen, puffy face following Hermione's Stinging Jinx, sneering as Snatchers tie up the trio.
observable_claims: Snatchers surround captured trio with lantern

action: presses faces against wet exterior glass window of boathouse whispering
dialogue_ref: Shh! Look, he's in there with him.
visual_description: Harry, Ron, and Hermione crouch on the wet rocky bank, peering through the frosted window into the dimly lit boathouse interior.
observable_claims: Trio presses faces against glass pane

action: sits on pure white bench speaking warmly to Harry in celestial King's Cross
location: Blinding white ethereal King's Cross station limbo
visible_objects: arched glass station ceiling in mist
dialogue_ref: Of course it is happening inside your head, Harry, but why on earth should that mean that it is not real?
visual_description: Dumbledore, wearing pristine white robes, strolls beside Harry along the mist-filled white platforms of a dreamlike King's Cross station.
observable_claims: Dumbledore and Harry in all-white station

action: kneels beside son Albus Severus on crowded platform reassuring him about Slytherin
dialogue_ref: Albus Severus Potter. You were named for two headmasters of Hogwarts. One of them was a Slytherin, and he was probably the bravest man I ever knew.
visual_description: An adult Harry kneels by his anxious young son Albus on the bustling platform, looking him in the eyes as steam curls around the red train.
observable_claims: Adult Harry kneels talking to young son

action: dissolves and disintegrates into black ash and fluttering ribbon flakes in ruined courtyard
visual_description: Voldemort's body peels away and disintegrates into floating black confetti ash blowing away in the courtyard wind after his curse rebounds.
observable_claims: Voldemort chest and face disintegrating into ash

action: catches the flying Elder Wand in mid-air as Voldemort's Avada Kedavra rebounds
visual_description: Harry Potter catches the spinning Elder Wand out of the air as the golden collision rebounds against Voldemort.

action: casts Expelliarmus clashing red and green beam against Voldemort's killing curse
visible_objects: red and green spell beam collision
visual_description: Intense clash of red and green magical jets between Harry and Voldemort across the ruined courtyard.
observable_claims: Red and green spell beams colliding

action: snaps the Elder Wand in half with bare hands and throws pieces into the chasm
visual_description: Harry Potter grips the Elder Wand with both hands, snaps the wood in two, and throws the fragments over the viaduct railing.
observable_claims: Hermione and Ron watching in shock

action: packs car boot hurriedly and drives away from Privet Drive forever
dialogue_ref: Come on, Dudley, hurry up.
visual_description: The Dursley family packs suitcases into their car boot outside Privet Drive and drives away, leaving Harry behind.

action: walks through the empty stripped bedroom and hallway of Privet Drive alone
visual_description: Harry stands in the empty, silent bedroom of Privet Drive looking out the window as the car departs.

action: bounces on bed warning Harry about dark plot at Hogwarts
dialogue_ref: Dobby has come to tell you... Harry Potter must not go back to Hogwarts school of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
visual_description: Dobby the house-elf stands and jumps on Harry bed in ragged pillowcase, passionately warning him.

action: punishes himself by banging head against wall and wardrobe
dialogue_ref: Bad Dobby! Bad Dobby!
visual_description: Dobby repeatedly slams his head against the door and wardrobe in self-punishment for speaking ill of his master.

action: seizes desk lamp and beats himself around the head
dialogue_ref: Bad Dobby! Bad Dobby!
visual_description: Dobby grabs Harry desk lamp and violently whacks himself over the head while Harry desperately tries to wrench it away.

action: levitates pudding cake threatening Harry
dialogue_ref: Harry Potter must say he is not going back to school.
visual_description: Dobby hovers the large cream pudding cake in the air, defying Harry.

action: walks imperiously kicking Dobby forward while holding silver snake cane
visual_description: Lucius Malfoy walking imperiously with his snake-headed cane looking sneeringly down as Dobby cringes at his heels.

action: holds up sock in wonderment realizing freedom and snaps fingers blasting Lucius backward down stairs
visual_description: Dobby holding up the sock in sheer wonderment realizing he is free, blasting Lucius backward down corridor.

action: flock of post owls swoops through Great Hall dropping letters and parcels onto breakfast tables
dialogue_ref: Mail's here!
visual_description: Flock of school post owls sweeps dramatically into the Great Hall carrying parcels and letters down to seated students.

action: unwraps parcel revealing glass Remembrall ball in grey sweater vest
dialogue_ref: Hey, look, Neville's got a Remembrall!
visual_description: Neville opens brown paper box at Gryffindor breakfast table revealing clear spherical glass Remembrall.

action: close-up of glass Remembrall ball in Neville hand glowing with swirling red smoke
dialogue_ref: I've read about those. When the smoke turns red, it means you've forgotten something.
visual_description: Close-up of glass Remembrall in Neville's hand glowing with vivid crimson smoke, then medium shot of Neville bewildered in grey sweater vest.

action: sitting at Gryffindor table dressed in full black Hogwarts school robes reading mail
dialogue_ref: Can I borrow this?
visual_description: Harry and Ron sit at table wearing proper black school robes over uniform ties reading the Daily Prophet.
observable_claims: Harry and Ron wearing black robes
Hermione in foreground in black robe

action: close-up of Neville sitting in knit sweater vest and tie admitting he forgot his cloak
dialogue_ref: The only problem is, I can't remember what I've forgotten.
visual_description: Close-up of Neville looking at classmates in his grey sweater vest and tie, having forgotten his black robe cloak.
